sources.title: ICML Tutorial Foundations of Data-efficient Machine Learning
sources.snippet: The goal of this tutorial will be to provide a unifying perspective, by discussing recent theoretically-rigorous approaches for data-efficient machine learning. We will discuss rigorous techniques for data-efficient supervised learning, and self-supervised contrastive pre-training.

sources.title: [2402.09668] How to Train Data-Efficient LLMs - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The training of large language models (LLMs) is expensive. In this paper, we study data-efficient approaches for pre-training LLMs, i.e., techniques that aim to optimize the Pareto frontier of model quality and training resource/data consumption. sources.title: Data Efficient learning | AI Research Papers
sources.snippet: Meta-learning (learning to learn): Training models that can quickly adapt to new tasks and environments. By enabling models to learn effectively from small datasets, data-efficient learning paves the way for wider adoption of AI in scenarios where data is scarce and valuable, leading to more practical and sustainable AI solutions.

sources.title: Data Efficient Learning - Virtusa
sources.snippet: Data efficient learning is a type of machine learning that can understand complex domains without the need for large amounts of data.
